commenti.body:
I felt the same about Afterlife at first, but on further rewatches it has started to grow on me. It really nails the vibe of Ghostbusters, and it is a touching tribute to Harold. I still feel that the final showdown takes place at a bit of an anti-climactic location, but on rewatches even that doesn't bother me that much any more. It just gets so much right. So for me, I rate the movies:

1. Ghostbusters (the original)
2. Ghostbusters 2
3. Ghostbusters Afterlife

I'm going to ignore that other movie, and I think we probably all should.

It surprises me that *Ghostbusters II* has had this modern-day resurrection. In initial release, audiences and critics really disliked it. My friends and I thought it was trash. I re-watched it about 6 years ago, and liked it even less. The lukewarm reception of II killed any prospect of a third.

Now, decades later, it's a *classic*. It still has terrible VFX, a script that makes no sense and a script that completely falls apart in the third act, but here we are. I guess age clouds all sins.
